maddeler.e:
اعتبرن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَبَرْنَ (iʕtabarna) /iʕ.ta.bar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# اُعْتُبِرْنَ (uʕtubirna) /uʕ.tu.bir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# اِعْتَبِرْنَ (iʕtabirna) /iʕ.ta.bir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
